summary: Corrected datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/scout_manifest.json territory.seed_doi from invalid 10.7554/eLife.35326 to Crossref-verified Streichan et al. (2018) landmark DOI 10.7554/eLife.27454, aligning scout provenance with paper_citations.bib and global_morphogenetic_flow_reference.json. Preserved the erroneous value as seed_doi_superseded with a top-level seed_doi_correction note.
root_cause: Scout dossier seed_doi was set to 10.7554/eLife.35326, which does not resolve (Crossref API 'Resource not found', doi.org HTTP 404). The dataset's canonical bibliography and reference JSON already used 10.7554/eLife.27454 for the title 'Global morphogenetic flow is accurately predicted by the spatial distribution of myosin motors' (Streichan et al., eLife 2018). The 35326 value is not a distinct citing publication—likely a scout transposition/typo—not a second eLife article.
evidence: Crossref GET https://api.crossref.org/works/10.7554/eLife.27454 → title contains 'Global morphogenetic flow', DOI 10.7554/elife.27454

validation.name: GMF DOI consistency
argv: import json,pathlib; m=json.load(open('datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/scout_manifest.json')); b=pathlib.Path('datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/paper_citations.bib').read_text(); assert '10.7554/eLife.27454' in b; print(m)
